title: Studio All-metadata form: the object-reference picker (for example Page → Object) lists bare machine names instead of labels
body:
qa#3 · os-tesla · session_01L9qibw6yXcLi9aRRBpPT4W

QA-source: #33096 · ux-conventions.labels-over-machine-names · observed beside the clauses

**Found:** QA run of `touched:ee9ad834` at objectstack main `8e3d4a54` (18.4.0 round 2, part B, browser slice), during the off-clause probe. Seen on two fresh loads.

## Repro
1. Create a writable package with an object whose label differs from its name, for example `r5lbl_item` labelled "R5 Label Item".
2. Studio → All metadata → Page → Create new.
3. The Object select lists 127 bare names (`r5lbl_item`, `showcase_account`, …).

In the same build, the flow trigger Object picker and the Lookup Related-object picker both show "R5 Label Item" with a small mono `r5lbl_item` under it.

**Expected (ux-conventions.labels-over-machine-names):** the label as the primary text, with the machine name secondary.

## Mechanism
`RefObjectWidget` (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/metadata-admin/widgets.tsx`, around L507–580) renders `<SelectItem>{n}</SelectItem>` from the names only, with no label.
